Use case: scientific-educational. Create a brand NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook; all supplied images are EXTERNAL scientific mechanism references only, not edit targets or layout templates. Invent a fresh clear composition appropriate to the following objects and relations. Flat 2D technical illustration, pure #FFFFFF background and perfectly uniform solid opaque fills. Lancet muted Blue #7B95C6, Green #67A583, Peach #FFC1A6 and Rose #C85E62 with very pale fixed white mixes. Neutral thin wires #4C4D4F. Many modules can remain white with colored outlines; restrained pale grouping only where it explains a relation. Crisp planar mechanism glyphs and accurate connections, readable blank areas. No 3D, perspective, side faces, extrusions, shadows, gloss, gradients, paper/canvas texture, noise, grain, waves, stripes, cloudy color variation or decorative card grids. At most one decorative icon per frame; equivalent frames consistently use the same or no icon. Mechanism nodes, vectors, documents and samples are allowed. NO text, letters, digits, formulas, plus/minus signs, pseudowriting, watermark or legends anywhere. Reserve adjacent or internal blank title/variable spaces; all lettering added later from actual fonts. Never put a decorative icon where a title must sit. Generous outer white margins. Landscape composition.
Scientific mechanism: DP-SGD order of operations, illustratively exactly THREE example lanes. Each lane: one separate training sample glyph → its individual gradient vector → an individual norm clipping operator → a clipped vector. All THREE clipped vectors merge only AFTER clipping into ONE aggregate/sum operator. A separate Gaussian-noise input enters this aggregate result ONLY once, through ONE addition operator after the sum. Then ONE normalization-by-batch-size operator → ONE parameter-update module → updated model parameters. Reserve a small separate accountant module connected by a dashed control/record arrow from the update for cumulative privacy accounting; not a data path feeding raw gradients back. A thin iteration indication may connect updated parameters to the next batch, but no raw sample or unclipped gradient can bypass clipping. Gradient vectors can be planar bars or arrows with different lengths before clipping and capped after clipping; do not fabricate numerical chart data. Leave readable title strips above the three example lanes and each operator. No literal math operators, all operator circles blank for later actual-font symbols. Reference contributions: exact Abadi algorithm order and Opacus per-example clipping depiction.

science_brief.title: DP-SGD逐样本更新与隐私会计
science_brief.understanding_gap: 现有差分隐私图解释邻接计数和噪声分布，没有显示为何必须逐样本裁剪；正文明确指出整批先汇总后裁剪不能沿用相同分析。
proposed_mechanism: 批次内每个样本独立求梯度gi并以阈值c裁剪，裁剪结果先求和，然后在聚合结果上加高斯噪声，再归一化并更新θ。
噪声输入仅到聚合节点，循环产生隐私代价并累计会计；匹配保护单位和抽样约定。
显示正确先后次序，不画具体噪声实测分布。

215: 训练算法通过许多更新累积单个样本的影响。\term{差分隐私随机梯度下降}（differentially private stochastic gradient descent, DP-SGD）通过限制样本梯度并对聚合结果加噪，构造可以进行组合分析的更新\scite{abadi2016dp}。

caption: 批次内独立计算各样本梯度 g_i，先按阈值 c 裁剪：clip_c(g_i)=g_i min{1,c/‖g_i‖₂}。裁剪后的梯度求和后加入高斯噪声 Z，再除以批次大小 b 并更新参数。隐私账本累计抽样率 q、噪声尺度 σ 和更新步数 T 等条件下的消耗，需与保护单位、邻接和抽样约定匹配。向量长度与高斯曲线仅为机制示意。
